The '''Fourth Outer Rim Army''', also known as the '''4th Sector Army''', '''White Cuirass Command''', and simply the '''Fourth Army''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of [[Sector 4]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> Initially assigned to Sector 4 as part of the [[Sector Army/Legends|Reserve Sector Armies]], the 4th Sector Army served as a reserve command for Republic campaigns in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Late in the war, it became known as the '''Outer Rim Sector Army''' while serving alongside the [[Thirteenth Army]] in the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. It contained [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]] [[Bacara/Legends|CC-1138's]] [[Galactic Marines/Legends|21st Nova Corps]]. The 4th Sector Army eventually saw action within their own theater late into the Clone Wars, when it participated in the [[Battle on Neimoidia/Legends|battle of Neimoidia]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
